task:
A gross settlement of 6120 credits is reduced by 12%. The reduced figure includes a 48% fee measured on its fee-free base; remove that included fee by division. Then add 3% of the ORIGINAL gross settlement. What is the exact result? Do not round. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 4 credits, then discount the whole amount by 15%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 15 credits, then discount the whole amount by 15%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 16% surcharge, then subtract 14 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 27 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 3% surcharge, then subtract 4 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 6 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 4% surcharge, then subtract 8 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 19 credits, then discount the whole amount by 12%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 8% surcharge, then subtract 22 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 12%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 4 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 27 credits, then discount the whole amount by 16%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 9 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 9 credits, then discount the whole amount by 15%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 18% surcharge, then subtract 12 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 13%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 3% surcharge, then subtract 7 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 5 credits, then discount the whole amount by 7%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
